metadata.re_freeze_reason: The 2026-06-12 SAM methyltransferase setup wires a new mechanism family into the admission engine -- sam_methyltransferase (EC 2.1.1 scope, SAM/SAH Rhea participant or Methyltransferase keyword mechanism handle, explicit no-Fe-S radical-SAM guard) -- expanding the positive fingerprint universe 14 -> 15. The 14fp-era pre-registration's inverse-gate universe is now a strict subset of the live registry, so it is re-frozen against the 15-fingerprint universe before the next OOS hard-negative tranche. NOTE: the OOS inverse gate cannot certify a clean hard-negative until the new positive fingerprint has atlas coverage, so a new OOS tranche stays blocked on coverage until then.

frozen_rules.abstention_threshold: Use threshold policy external_hard_negative_threshold_policy_v1_2026_05_17 at floor 0.4115 unless a separately justified global calibration creates a new threshold policy version.
admissible_source_evidence: explicit active-site or catalytic residue evidence
specific catalytic activity or reaction evidence
coordinate mapping for the scored local active-site features
duplicate_rules: reject near-duplicate sequence evidence at the active threshold
screen external candidates all-vs-all before terminal import
structural_neighborhood_rules: native M-CSA strict TM-diverse holdout claims stay disabled
strict TM-diverse evaluation belongs on external fold-diverse structural data
structure clusters must be assigned before split construction
success_criteria: all current fingerprint scores are below 0.4115
terminal review accepts out-of-scope only for label_factory_v1_15fp
full label-factory and external-transfer gates pass
failure_criteria: any current fingerprint score reaches or exceeds 0.4115
duplicate or structural-neighborhood controls flag a current-countable neighbor

warnings: This artifact re-freezes the next external hard-negative tranche against the current 15-fingerprint universe before candidate selection; it does not import labels.

The 14fp-era pre-registration (v3_external_hard_negative_next_tranche_preregistration_14fp_1025.json) is SUPERSEDED and kept on disk only as the historical record; the 12fp- and 8fp-era ones remain superseded as well.
External out_of_scope labels remain scoped to ontology_version_at_decision and must be re-audited after any further positive fingerprint expansion.

The OOS inverse gate requires every current fingerprint scored; the new positive fingerprint (sam_methyltransferase) has no atlas coverage yet, so the inverse gate reports incomplete-coverage until it is populated.
